question: 购买曲目数量最多的前五个音乐流派是什么？
answer: 已按发票明细的 Quantity 汇总销量，并通过 tracks 关联流派。具体前五名及数量见 queries 中的真实结果。

queries.sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, SUM(ii.Quantity) AS quantity FROM genres AS g JOIN tracks AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN invoice_items AS ii ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY quantity DESC, g.GenreId ASC LIMIT 5
